pr_title: Make Huawei LTE notify service name configurable
pr_body:
## Breaking Change:

<!-- What is breaking and why we have to break it. Remove this section only if it was NOT a breaking change. -->

Default name for the Huawei LTE notify service has changed to `notify.huawei_lte` to avoid conflicts with other notify services. An option to provide name for the service has also been added.

## Description:


**Related issue (if applicable):** fixes #29409

**Pull request with documentation for [home-assistant.io](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io) (if applicable):** home-assistant/home-assistant.io#11535

## Example entry for `configuration.yaml` (if applicable):
```yaml
huawei_lte:
  - url: ...
    password: ...
    notify:
      name: sms
```

## Checklist:
  - [x] The code change is tested and works locally.
  - [ ] Local tests pass with `tox`. **Your PR cannot be merged unless tests pass**
  - [x] There is no commented out code in this PR.
  - [x] I have followed the [development checklist][dev-checklist]

If user exposed functionality or configuration variables are added/changed:
  - [x] Documentation added/updated in [home-assistant.io](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io)

If the code communicates with devices, web services, or third-party tools:
  - [ ] [_The manifest file_][manifest-docs] has all fields filled out correctly. Update and include derived files by running `python3 -m script.hassfest`.
  - [ ] New or updated dependencies have been added to `requirements_all.txt` by running `python3 -m script.gen_requirements_all`.
  - [ ] Untested files have been added to `.coveragerc`.

If the code does not interact with devices:
  - [ ] Tests have been added to verify that the new code works.

[dev-checklist]: https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/en/development_checklist.html
[manifest-docs]: https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/en/creating_integration_manifest.html

issue_context.title: [Huawei_LTE] no notify service
issue_context.body:
Hello,

I am using HA version 0.102.3 running os HassIO and I have huawei LTE router B525s-23a. My configuration looks like this:
```
huawei_lte:
  - url: http://192.168.1.1/
    username: !secret huawei_username
    password: !secret huawei_password
    notify:
      recipient:
        - +48XXXXXXXXX
```

and I do not see any notify service related to it. Before changes I had it done via

```
notify:
  - name: notify_huawei
    platform: huawei_lte
    ....
```
and It worked well. More info available [here](https://community.home-assistant.io/t/huawei-lte-in-version-0-102-problem/149863)
I can also see its configuration via HA Integrations page:
![obraz](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/21099773/70140789-cc322d00-1695-11ea-9973-b84587181663.png)

> I got message in app, but not in SMS.

Yes, I believe this is because both your app's and Huawei LTE's notification services register under the name `notify.notify`, and for you the message happens to end up in the app. As said, we need to do something about this, probably by providing a better default name for the Huawei LTE notification service (e.g. `notify.huawei_lte`) and maybe a way for users to supply a name for it.

review_comments: Should we set a default name here too?
No, because otherwise default will propagate to a "set in yaml" value and thus override whatever is set in config entry options.
Only if the user uses config yaml and only if the name changes, right? So the user can still override from options.
I noticed that the overriding doesn't actually work as intended. But it's nothing new related to this PR, it was already broken before. Filed #30221 for that.
